info.name: Creates a job to complete multiple target groups

params.name: account_id
params.description: The account's unique identifier.

params.name: project_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the project, in ULID format.

items.docs:
This endpoint creates a bulk job to complete fielding runs for a list of specified target group IDs. This action will immediately complete the 
specified target groups, regardless of whether their completes goals or end dates have been reached.
If a target group is already completed, the system considers the action successful.

items.docs:
This endpoint retrieves the status and details of a previously created bulk-complete job using its job ID.

You should poll this endpoint periodically until the `status` field is either `Completed` or `Failed`. If the status is `Processing`, the job is still running.
Once the job is finished, the `updated_target_groups` and `failed_target_groups` lists will show the outcome for each target group included in the original request.

info.name: Creates a job to launch multiple target groups

params.name: account_id
params.description: The account's unique identifier.

params.name: project_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the project, in ULID format.

items.docs:
This endpoint creates a bulk job to launch fielding runs for a list of specified target group IDs. This action will start the fielding runs 
for the specified target groups, updating their fielding start date to the current time. A fielding run can only be launched if it is in a 
'scheduled' state.
